intro: Marshal Redpath in Southshore warns that Crushridge ogres have settled by the ruins of Alterac and claimed them. A bounty is offered to anyone who will go north into the Alterac Mountains and hunt them.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Crushridge ogres have dug an ogre mound up in the Alterac Mountains near the ruined city of Alterac. And my scouts tell me they've taken over those ruins as well.
We can't let them get cozy up there; if they think they're safe where they are, then their next step will be to move down into the foothills, which will put them right at our front door!
Go north to the Alterac Mountains and hunt ogres. Bring me the Dirty Knucklebones they carry and you will earn a nice bounty.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Friend, are you still hunting ogres? Do you have the knucklebones I had you gather?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Very good, friend. You must have hacked through a whole mess of ogres to get all these knucklebones.
That should keep them out of our hair. At least, for a while.
